---
title: "Evaluate"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(yardstick)
library(ggview)
```

```{r}
result <- read_csv("results/data/result_test1.csv")
```

```{r}
my_metrics <- metric_set(roc_auc, pr_auc, accuracy, bal_accuracy, f_meas, sens, spec)

eva_result <- result |>
  mutate(pred = as.factor(pred), true = as.factor(true)) |>
  group_by(feature_type) |>
  my_metrics(truth = true, estimate = pred, prob, event_level = "second") |>
  select(feature_type, metric = .metric, score = .estimate) |>
  mutate(metric = case_match(
    metric,
    "roc_auc" ~ "ROC AUC",
    "pr_auc" ~ "PR AUC",
    "accuracy" ~ "Accuracy",
    "bal_accuracy" ~ "Balanced Accuracy",
    "f_meas" ~ "F1 Score",
    "sens" ~ "Sensitivity",
    "spec" ~ "Specificity",
  ))
```

```{r}
p <- eva_result |>
  mutate(
    feature_type = str_remove(feature_type, " \\(\\d+\\)"),
    feature_type = factor(feature_type, levels = c("Only Peptides", "Only Clinics", "All Features")),
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(score, metric, fill = feature_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)(score), color = ), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Oranges", name = "Feature Type") +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  canvas(width = 6, height = 4)

save_ggplot(p, "results/figures/evaluate.pdf")
```
